# hvrc · place

> The portfolio, playground and digital hub of Harsh Rajmachikar — a developer
> working across software, games and music, who spends his time studying
> technologies and building things with them.

Harsh Rajmachikar (handle: **hvrc**) is a Creative Systems Developer at Iseehear.
He has previously worked as a Freelance Software Developer at Getafix Design, an
Integrations Engineer at Healthy Planet, and a Data Analyst at Gromor Finance.

hvrc.place serves three purposes at once: it is his portfolio, a playground where
he uploads experiments as he builds them, and the central hub linking the rest of
his work online. The site itself is one of the experiments — the interface is a
recreation of the PlayStation Portable's XMB menu, built in React.

## What he builds

- **Software** — web apps, tools and APIs (Python, TypeScript, React, Flask, Node)
- **Games** — Carrom, RTS (a WordNet word-association game), Prim's Organism
- **Generative art & simulation** — hॐ, Conway's Game of Life, flocking and dithering studies
- **Music** — production, plus instruments like Boteh, a synthesiser played with hand gestures tracked by a camera
- **Hardware** — a MIDI controller built with Arduino and C++

## Pages

- [Home](https://hvrc.place/): the XMB menu — profile, projects, experience, links and settings
- [hॐ](https://hvrc.place/hom): generative art made with flocking and dithering
- [Prim's Organism](https://hvrc.place/prim): a game built on Prim's maze generation
- [Resume](https://hvrc.place/resume)
